learning_objective: 🎯 Understand how a small peasant's determination led to the first triumph of civil disobedience in India and taught the nation the lesson of self-reliance.

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: बटाईदार (फसल का हिस्सा देने वाला किसान)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Poor peasants in Champaran were forced by British landlords to plant 15% of their land with indigo and surrender the entire harvest as rent. Rajkumar Shukla, a resolute illiterate peasant, followed Gandhi everywhere until Gandhi agreed to visit Champaran.

When Germany developed synthetic indigo, the British landlords didn't need natural indigo anymore. They deceitfully forced peasants to sign agreements paying 'compensation' to be freed from the 15% arrangement.

Gandhi arrived to investigate but was ordered to leave the district. He refused, signing a receipt stating he would disobey the order. Thousands of peasants gathered in his support, forcing the government to release him without bail.

An official inquiry was set up. The landlords agreed to refund 25% of the money they had illegally taken. Gandhi accepted this because the amount mattered less than the fact that the landlords were forced to surrender part of their money and their prestige.

Gandhi didn't just solve the political issue. He saw the cultural and social backwardness in Champaran. He brought in volunteers (including his wife Kasturba) to open primary schools and teach sanitation and personal hygiene.

fun_activity.title: ✊ The Power of Stubbornness
fun_activity.instructions: Rajkumar Shukla's 'resolute' nature changed history. Think of a time when your sheer stubbornness helped you achieve something good. Write one sentence describing it!

exam_tips: 📌 Why did Gandhi agree to a 25% refund instead of 100%? To break the deadlock. It broke the myth of the British landlords' invincibility and taught the peasants courage.

📌 Know the role of Charles Freer Andrews: Gandhi's lawyer friends wanted this English pacifist to stay and help, but Gandhi refused, saying they must rely upon themselves (Self-reliance), not on an Englishman.
📌 Always mention that the Champaran episode was a turning point in Gandhi's life as it marked the beginning of his active involvement in India's freedom struggle.
quick_recap: ⭐ Rajkumar Shukla is described as 'poor, emaciated, and illiterate, but resolute'.
⭐ The lawyers initially charged heavy fees from the poor peasants, which Gandhi strongly scolded them for.
⭐ Champaran was not just a political victory; it was a victory over the peasants' deeply ingrained fear of the British.
